name: local-context
description: Per-feature working memory in .local_context/<feature>/ — CURRENT.md, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, ARCHIVE.md. `local-context-new` creates it, `local-context-continue` resumes it, `local-context-start` does both, `local-context-tidy` cleans it, `local-context-business-questions` lists the decisions the business owes.
